paragraphs:
The XF 3.0d is part of the original X250 generation of the XF, produced from 2007 to 2015. It uses the Ford AJD V6 — a 2.7L or 3.0L V6 diesel unit shared with other Jaguar and Land Rover models of the era. The XF 3.0d sat alongside the 2.2 Diesel and 2.7d in the X250 diesel line-up, offering a smooth, refined V6 diesel option in Jaguar's first-generation XF. The X250 generation was replaced by the X260 in 2015, which introduced a completely different range of Ingenium engines.

The XF 3.0d is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace Ford AJD V6 engines for every XF 3.0d on the road.
